title: Real-time and efficient multi-target speech extraction via target-direction-agnostic feature extraction and late steering-vector fusion
descriptive_tagline: One shared representation. Multiple target speakers.

affiliations.name: Key Laboratory of Noise and Vibration Research, Institute of Acoustics, Chinese Academy of Sciences
University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
School of Physics and Optoelectronics, South China University of Technology

method_description: A direction-agnostic front end computes mixture features once. A parameter-shared beamforming head combines those features with each requested steering direction to produce target-specific spatial weights.
curation_disclosure: These listening examples are curated to illustrate the method's strengths. Aggregate test-set results are reported separately.
mixture_snr_definition: Nominal SNR is the power ratio of summed full-reverberant speech to additive non-speech noise, averaged over time and all six microphones. It is not an individual target-to-noise ratio.
target_reference: Early-reflected target speech at microphone0, including the direct path and reflections within20ms after it.

latency.hardware: Intel Core i9-10900, one pinned logical CPU, PyTorch intra/inter-op threads1/1
latency.protocol: Warm-loaded software waveform input/output;3 paced replays of the same10s six-channel recording. P95 is computed per trial on regular output after1s, then the three P95 values are summarized by their median.
latency.includes: Input buffering, computation, scheduling and queueing
latency.excludes: Model/file loading, DOA estimation and audio-device/ADC/DAC buffers

aggregate_quality.caution: PESQ/ESTOI mean differences are small; DNSMOS does not favor Late in this matched aggregate comparison. PESQ has missing-score policies; prefer SI-SDR for the demo headline.

doa_robustness.scope: Two-source matched models, both targets requested; outputs evaluated against requested target without permutation. Antipodal targets use a tie-breaking arc convention.

angular_separation.scope: 100 matched acoustic base configurations, four noise settings, both targets; true requested DOA.
angular_separation.limitation: Small target/interferer separations remain challenging; the average SI-SDR is negative at10degrees.

jnf_shared_scope: Shared JNF-SSF is a noncausal configuration. Its listening results must not inherit the causal Lightweight latency claim.
listening_runtime_boundary: Listening examples are prerecorded offline evaluation outputs. Streaming timings were measured separately with a causal-gain software pipeline; they are not a browser inference benchmark or an online speech-quality reevaluation.
three_target_comparison_label: Matched Lightweight models, N=3:4.90 versus7.62 GMAC/s; approximately36% fewer operations.
